notes: Plain static site: tokens are CSS custom properties in styles.css :root (light) plus a prefers-color-scheme dark block; no component library; five HTML pages share app.js (rendering and logic) and styles.css. Locations found by reading the source (no data-insp-path in this build); line numbers point to the rendering line or the CSS rule that causes the defect. Design-critic duplicates sharing one root cause get the same ease. Read project source only as permitted; did not read builder notes or other evaluator outputs.
